name: Bartimaeus
bio: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, son of Timaeus, sat by the roadside at Jericho. When he heard Jesus passing by, he cried out, "Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me," and despite the crowd's rebukes, cried out all the louder. Jesus called him over, and when Bartimaeus asked for his sight, healed him through his faith; Bartimaeus immediately received his sight and followed Jesus (Mark 10:46-52). The same episode is told without naming him in Matthew 20:29-34, which describes two blind men.
